skill.name: influencer-discovery
skill.description: Use when you need to find influencers, build a creator list, or discover brand-fit candidates in a niche. It structures multi-platform discovery, public-signal screening, authenticity checks, profiles, and tiered shortlists. Use fit-scorer when you already have a known shortlist to rank.
skill.summary: Discovers and screens influencer candidates across platforms for brand-fit shortlists.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: The audit found no prompt injection, credential theft, arbitrary filesystem traversal, or malicious intent in the reviewed Markdown files. Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline code formatting, and example templates. The retained risks are an optional Python connector command and optional outbound oEmbed lookups, both legitimate but requiring disclosure and user consent.

Tell users before calling YouTube, TikTok, or X oEmbed endpoints, and avoid sending private campaign context or non-public creator data in those requests.

content.value_statement: Influencer discovery is slow when teams search platforms without shared criteria or screening rules. This skill turns a niche, platform, and campaign goal into a structured candidate pool, creator profiles, red-flag checks, and a tiered shortlist.
actual_capabilities: Defines search criteria for niche, platform, follower range, engagement, location, language, and exclusions.
Builds a multi-platform candidate pool using hashtags, similar accounts, competitor mentions, and user-provided creator data.
Screens creators for follower fit, engagement quality, activity, content relevance, authenticity, and brand-safety red flags.
Creates structured creator profiles with metrics, audience notes, content analysis, partnership history, contact paths, and preliminary fit scores.
Compiles discovery reports with shortlist tiers, platform mix, candidate counts, next steps, and handoff guidance for fit scoring.
limitations: It depends on public information, user-supplied data, or optional connector outputs, so metrics may need manual verification.
It produces preliminary fit scores only; the related fit-scorer skill handles final weighted ranking.
It does not guarantee creator availability, contact accuracy, fee ranges, or partnership acceptance.
It should not be used to scrape private data, bypass platform rules, or build unauthorized bulk creator databases.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator search
use_cases.description: Create a first-pass list of relevant creators for a new campaign, with filters for platform, niche, follower band, and engagement quality.

use_cases.title: Expand a partner pipeline
use_cases.description: Find replacement creators or new micro-influencer prospects when an existing roster is small, stale, or concentrated on one platform.

use_cases.title: Map competitor overlap
use_cases.description: Identify creators who already work with competitors, then flag sponsorship saturation and exclusivity concerns before outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Find beginner creator candidates
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a simple niche search with basic criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 20 influencers in [niche] for [brand or product]. Focus on [platforms], [location], and creators with [follower range]. Include why each creator may fit.

prompt_templates.title: Build a screened shortlist
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply follower, engagement, and brand-safety filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a shortlist of [count] [platform] creators in [niche]. Require [follower range], engagement above [minimum], recent posting activity, and no obvious brand-safety red flags.

prompt_templates.title: Create creator profiles
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn candidate handles into usable evaluation profiles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Profile these creators for [brand]: [handles]. For each one, summarize audience signal, content style, recent engagement quality, partnership history, contact path, concerns, and preliminary fit score.

prompt_templates.title: Run advanced discovery workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a full campaign brief and competitor context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run influencer discovery for [campaign goal] in [niche]. Use [platforms], [target audience], [budget tier], [competitor brands], exclusions, and [location or language]. Produce candidate pool stats, tiered recommendations, trend insights, and next-step handoff notes.

output_examples.input: Find 15 sustainable fashion micro-influencers for a new eco clothing brand.
output_examples.output: A discovery report with search criteria, 43 reviewed candidates, 15 qualified creators, top recommendations by tier, audience and engagement notes, and next steps for final scoring.

output_examples.input: Profile five TikTok creators for a clean beauty launch.
output: A profile for each creator with handle, niche, platform mix, visible engagement signal, content style, brand-fit notes, partnership history, public contact path, and concerns.
A tiered shortlist that separates must-reach creators from strong candidates and creators worth monitoring.

output_examples.input: Find creators my competitors already sponsor in the fitness niche.
output_examples.output: A competitor-aware candidate list that flags repeated partnerships, possible exclusivity, saturation risk, and creators who may require deeper review before outreach.

best_practices: Start with clear criteria for niche, platform, follower range, engagement floor, location, language, audience, and exclusions.
Verify recent content and comment quality before treating follower counts or engagement rates as reliable.
Send the final shortlist to fit-scorer before outreach when budget, risk, or ranking accuracy matters.
anti_patterns: Do not treat preliminary fit scores as final campaign investment decisions.
Do not guess private contact details or infer personal data that is not public.
Do not build bulk creator databases in ways that violate platform terms or user consent expectations.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces search criteria, a candidate pool, creator profiles, authenticity and brand-safety notes, shortlist tiers, and handoff guidance.

faq.question: Can it find influencers without paid tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It works with public information and user-provided inputs. Optional connectors can improve metrics when available.

faq.question: Does it rank a finished creator list?
faq.answer: No. It gives preliminary triage scores. Use fit-scorer for final weighted ranking of a known shortlist.

faq.question: Which platforms can it support?
faq.answer: It supports discovery workflows for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, and Reddit when relevant data is available.

faq.question: How does it handle authenticity checks?
faq.answer: It looks for engagement quality, comment patterns, posting recency, sponsorship saturation, fake-follower signals, and brand-safety concerns.

faq.question: Is it suitable for outreach automation?
faq.answer: No. It prepares discovery and profile data. Use an outreach-focused workflow after legal, consent, and brand checks are complete.
